description: The door, and not the plot

participation.context: Stood at the door, and left when it was done.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let the plot say the title and the hour. You brought no part-name home, and no account of the play.

title: Stood at the tiring-house door

participation.context: Told Burbage, and told Kemp to eat.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the king, and left Field the poems.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Stopped eating, tried the name once, and put the spoon down.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You gave Burbage the margin. Kemp stopped eating and tried the name once. You did not take it up with him.
